raw_response:
This rice plot is small, just over half a hectare, but rice needs fertilizer to give good grain — last year I put one bag of NPK and it helped, so I will do the same and add a little urea if money reaches. I save my own seed from last harvest because the improved rice from the dealer costs too much and I do not know it well. The weeds in rice are bad so I will spray small herbicide, and I work this plot with my wife and older children — I do not hire people except maybe at harvest when the birds come and we must cut fast.
